hypothesis: Removing only the fresh canonical breakout-onset requirement may recover repeatable ETH compression-pullback opportunities after realistic execution costs without degrading the frozen 60-bps stop behavior.
decision: Continue the isolated report-only observer and frozen future-only diagnostic unchanged. The second resolved long path lost after recorded visible-depth execution and fees; the two-path aggregate remains slightly positive only because of the first winner and becomes negative when that winner is removed. Do not add ETH or relax the onset requirement.
why_this_revision: The second preregistered non-overlapping 15-minute path resolved, converting the positive N=1 result into a one-win/one-loss, largest-winner-dependent N=2 sample.

future_one_blocker_experiment.candidate_definition: exactly two of three frozen entry conditions met with canonical_breakout_onset_absent as the sole blocker
future_one_blocker_experiment.entry: first complete visible-depth executable quote causally available after routing publication
future_one_blocker_experiment.overlap_policy: suppress additional same-side candidates until the primary horizon resolves
future_one_blocker_experiment.minimum_evidence: At least 20 independent candidates with both sides represented, complete exact-depth entry and exit paths, positive primary-horizon mean and median after nominal cost, positive stress mean after removing the largest winner, and no worse stop-path behavior than the frozen route.

right_boundary_candidate.interpretation: The candidate became available at the evidence boundary and had no subsequent book within the frozen prefix. A later prefix may resolve it; it is not treated as a loss, fill, or technical strategy fault.

interpretation.comparison_with_no_action: Keeping v53 unchanged remains preferred because the tiny positive aggregate is largest-winner dependent, entirely long-side, and only two resolved paths.

risks_and_failure_modes: Two results remain far below the predeclared twenty-candidate minimum.
Removing the largest winner makes the observed net result negative.
All resolved candidates are long-side, leaving the configured short side untested.
The right-boundary candidate lacked a later book in this immutable prefix and is excluded rather than guessed.
Recorded visible depth can cancel before a live IOC reaches the venue.
The stop proxy uses adverse BBO rather than an exact venue mark-trigger fill.
A fixed 15-minute diagnostic does not reproduce the route's full native maximum-hold lifecycle.

recommendation.Recommendation: Keep v53 and the ETH onset requirement unchanged; continue the frozen future-only experiment until its evidence contract resolves or is invalidated.
recommendation.Why now: The second path shows that the first winner was not yet repeatable and that the current aggregate fails largest-winner sensitivity.
recommendation.Evidence reviewed: Two resolved non-overlapping exact-depth paths, one right-boundary candidate, official funding, exact fees, visible-depth capacity, MFE/MAE, and the immutable N=1 revision.
recommendation.Observed problem or opportunity: Removing onset admitted one small winner and one smaller loss, for only 0.94 bps total and a negative result without the winner.
recommendation.Applicable market regime: Observed ETH transition and trend-up structure with prior compression and long pullbacks but no fresh canonical five-minute breakout onset.
recommendation.Alternatives considered: Promote after N=1, reject permanently after N=2, retune the horizon, change the stop, or continue the preregistered experiment.
recommendation.Expected upside: Continuing tests whether the marginal setup has repeatable both-side value without contaminating v53 capital or selecting on the first winner.
recommendation.Main risks and failure modes: Sparse variance, one-sided sampling, outlier dependence, recorded-book cancellation, mark-stop mismatch, and native-exit mismatch.
recommendation.Validation completed: Exact identity and cutoff, two causal entry/exit paths, non-overlap enforcement, visible-depth capacity, official fees and funding, MFE/MAE, stop proxy, and largest-winner sensitivity.
recommendation.Validation still required: At least eighteen additional independent resolved candidates, short-side evidence, full stress arithmetic, exact stop behavior, and native lifecycle comparison.
recommendation.Success metrics: The unchanged twenty-candidate both-side contract with positive nominal mean and median, positive stress result after largest-winner removal, and no worse stop behavior.
recommendation.Failure / rollback triggers: Negative, one-sided, unresolved, or outlier-dependent final evidence retains the current onset requirement; source or identity mismatch invalidates the window.
recommendation.Confidence level: high on N=2 arithmetic, low on long-run expectancy

next_highest_value_investigation: Resolve the next causally available ETH candidate without retuning while continuing exact v53 HYPE lifecycle collection.
